title: Wagon breakdown
text: A {part} has failed. Fit a spare or spend time making a repair.

choices.label: Fit a spare {part}
choices.result: The spare is fitted.

choices.label: Patch it · 2 days, 1 care kit
choices.result: The repair holds, for now.

choices.label: Make a wooden repair · 3 days
choices.result: Three days of work put the wagon back on the road.

title: An ox is lame
text: An ox injures its leg. Your team will pull more slowly until its condition improves.

choices.label: Rest the team · 1 day
choices.result: You give the team time to recover.

choices.label: Continue with the weakened team
choices.result: The injured team pulls at a slower pace.

title: An accident on the trail
text: {person} has a {injury}. Support the injured limb and stop to care for them.

choices.label: Use supplies for a support · 1 kit, 1 day
choices.result: You support the injured limb and stop to rest.

choices.label: Improvise a support · 2 days
choices.result: You improvise a support and make camp.

title: An ox wanders off
text: One animal is missing when you count the team.

choices.label: Search · 1 day
choices.result: You find the wandering ox.

choices.label: Continue without it
choices.result: You continue with a smaller team.

title: A traveler is missing
text: {person} has wandered away from the wagon. You stop and search.

choices.label: Search the trail · 1 day
choices.result: The searchers bring your companion back safely.

title: Unsafe water
text: The water here looks foul. A cleaner spring will take time to find.

choices.label: Find a clean spring · 1 day
choices.result: The party fills its containers at a spring.

choices.label: Press on with this water

risk.text: A traveler becomes ill after the stop.

choices.result: You continue without searching.

title: Supplies soaked by rain
text: Heavy rain gets into the load: 10 lb food, 20 bullets and 1 care kit are damaged, up to what you carried.

choices.label: Dry the load · 1 day
choices.result: You stop to dry and repack the remaining supplies.

title: A robbery on the road
text: Armed thieves demand money. Decide whether to surrender supplies, defend the wagon, or flee. Fighting can cause serious or fatal injury.

choices.label: Surrender $20
choices.result: The thieves leave with the money.

choices.label: Defend the wagon · 10 bullets

risk.text: A traveler is hit and suffers a serious wound. Such injuries can be fatal.

choices.result: The thieves retreat.

choices.label: Flee · 1 day, team strain
choices.result: You escape, but the team is strained.

title: Fire in the wagon
text: Fire damages 40 lb food, 40 bullets and 2 care kits, up to the stock you carried.

choices.label: Put out the fire and repack · 1 day
choices.result: You put out the last embers and salvage the load.

title: Lost in the fog
text: You cannot make out the trail ahead.

choices.label: Wait for visibility · 1 day
choices.result: You wait rather than risk losing the road.

title: Snakebite
text: {person} has been bitten by a snake. The party must stop and tend the injured traveler.

choices.label: Stop and use care supplies · 1 kit, 1 day
choices.result: You stop and attend to your companion. Watch their condition.

choices.label: Stop with the supplies available · 2 days
choices.result: You stop to care for the injured traveler.

title: Water enters the wagon
text: A flooded hollow soaks the load. You lose up to 30 lb food and 1 clothing set.

choices.label: Recover the load · 1 day
choices.result: You get the wagon back onto firm ground.

title: Animals at the food stores
text: Animals are getting into your provisions. Protect the stores or let them take some food.

choices.label: Drive them off · 2 bullets
choices.result: The noise drives the animals away.

choices.label: Leave them · lose up to 15 lb food
choices.result: The animals carry off some food.

title: A damaging hailstorm
text: Hail damages the wagon cover and provisions: up to 10 bullets and 1 care kit are lost.

choices.label: Repair the cover · 1 day
choices.result: You patch the cover before setting off again.

title: Illness in the party
text: {person} is exhausted and unwell. Check their personal condition and make time to rest.

choices.label: Stop to rest · 1 day
choices.result: You stop to let the party recover.

choices.label: Continue cautiously
choices.result: You will keep watching the sick traveler's condition.

title: Help along the trail
text: Other travelers share provisions and point you toward the next good stopping place.

choices.label: Accept their help
choices.result: You thank the travelers for 14 lb of food.

title: Riders on the road
text: Mounted strangers approach the wagon. You cannot yet judge their intentions. Fighting can cause serious or fatal injury.

choices.label: Run · 1 day, team strain
choices.result: You put distance between the wagon and the riders.

choices.label: Defend the wagon · 10 bullets

risk.text: A traveler is hit and suffers a serious wound. Such injuries can be fatal.

choices.result: The riders leave the wagon.

choices.label: Continue and watch

risk.text: The strangers steal up to $20 before leaving.

choices.result: You keep moving along the road.

choices.label: Circle and guard · 5 bullets, 1 day
choices.result: You take precautions and wait until the riders move on.

risk.text: A traveler is hit while guarding the wagon. The wound may be fatal to someone already weak.
